gated_opcodes_note: The annex assumed IsaProfile alone would close these. It does not: Opcode::is_experimental() returns false for every opcode in this revision, so the Production profile refuses nothing, and the mainnet activation gate is silent about storage (finding z10, measured). Changing is_experimental() upstream-style would turn pre-existing prover and VM tests red for reasons unrelated to them, which rule 6 forbids working around. The closure is therefore enforced additively on the Gate path and recorded here.

skipped_detail.why: GateClaim refuses a zero mint (NothingMinted, error #13), so a zero-total migration record cannot exist on-chain at all. Evaluated on the VM side, where the rung is 0. Finding z11.
Larger than the mocked CCTP message carries in that harness. The rung above Gold is already pinned on the Soroban side by the exact-Gold and just-above-Gold cases.

trace_hashes_note: sha256 over the ordered execution-trace rows (pc, next_pc, encoded instruction, operand slots and values), domain-separated by 'gate-tier-trace/v1'. Produced by `cargo run -p gate-tier-parity --example dump_evidence`. Each vector was run twice and the digests matched: determinism holds for all 12. Distinct inputs produce distinct digests, so the check cannot pass vacuously. THIS IS NOT A PROOF and nobody verifies it — it is a reproducibility digest.

findings.finding: gate2/zkvm/ already existed and already contained the proof half (zk-proof, zk-state, verifier-registry, note-packing) — precisely what the annex says not to take. Commit 28026a9, 2026-09-20 03:11 UTC, 'lumen-gate auditor', 62 files, 31687 insertions, on main. Reported as a stop before any file was written; operator instructed to proceed and take what testnet needs (decision d2).

That pre-existing tree is a renamed copy of the same budzero/ workspace this annex targets. Normalising only the rename gives 0 differing lines in zk-isa, ast.rs, codegen.rs, lexer.rs, parser.rs, private_transfer.rs, syscall_context.rs and trace_fixtures.rs; zk-vm/src/lib.rs is 2579 lines on both sides with 8 differing.

The source project's name appears nowhere in the workspace (grep -ri 'budlum|budzero|budzkvm' over *.rs/*.toml/*.md returns 0 matches), conflicting with annex §1 'existing copyright lines are not deleted'. Predates this work. Operator chose to continue the scrub (decision d3); LICENSE and PROVENANCE.md now carry the attribution trail instead.

No LICENSE, PROVENANCE.md, STATUS.md or evidence.json accompanied the pre-existing tree, though its crates declare LicenseRef-PolyForm-Shield-1.0.0. All four added by this work; LICENSE vendored byte-identical from the source.

The annex (§1) states the sources are MIT. The selected source is PolyForm Shield 1.0.0, which carries a Noncompete clause. Only Budlum/BudZKVM is MIT. No legal interpretation offered; recorded so PROVENANCE.md does not carry a false 'MIT summary'. Operator kept budzero/ (decision d1).

The pre-existing tree had no rust-toolchain.toml, so it silently built on the root's 1.98.1 while the source pins 1.97.1 — rule 4 isolation was incomplete. Pinned to 1.97.1 by this work; the root toolchain was not touched and the 1.0 floor still passes.

Z1 dependency analysis is clean: bud-isa has no path dependencies; bud-vm and bud-compiler depend only on bud-isa (plus serde/logos/tracing). References to bud_proof or bud_state in their sources: 0. The execution/proof boundary is real, so the 'cannot be separated' stop condition did not fire.

The predicted README contradiction is confirmed. Budlum/BudZKVM: '31/31 opcodes production-ready' including VerifyMerkle at 64 depth. budzero/: VerifyMerkle mainnet-gated, default off; root README calls the production-depth path disabled. Safe reading adopted.

The pre-existing tree is not wired to any Soroban contract, BurnRouter, GateClaim or web flow (grep across contracts, crates, web, scripts, frontend, api: no references). Rule 3 is intact today. The single match, zk_proof_len in crates/source_simulator, is an unrelated local constant.

IsaProfile::Production gates nothing in this ISA revision. Measured: VerifyMerkle, SRead and SWrite all decode successfully under Production, because Opcode::is_experimental() is hardcoded to return false. MainnetActivation::default() rejects VerifyMerkle but accepts both storage opcodes. Rule 2 therefore could not be satisfied by selecting a profile, and is enforced by parity/src/gate_profile.rs on the Gate path instead.

The zero-amount parity vector cannot be exercised on the Soroban side: GateClaim rejects a zero mint with NothingMinted (#13), so a zero-total migration record cannot exist on-chain. Checked on the VM side only, where the rung is 0; the skip is recorded in the test itself and in parity.skipped_detail rather than silently passed.

acceptance.Z3: met — 12 shared vectors, VM side 12/12, Soroban side 10/10 with 2 documented skips, both reading the same JSON file; trace hashes recorded; determinism verified by a second run of every vector
acceptance.Z4: met — STATUS.md carries the 'half a job' banner at the top and every line has a counterpart here or in PROVENANCE.md
